source_annotation_corrections.basis: Source class2 bbox covers a red outfield player wearing number4, duplicated by object19. Agent retains object19 as player; original file unchanged.

excluded_scout_sources.reason: Combined/occluded goalkeeper-player proposals not fully resolved; not admitted.
Insufficient clear yellow counterexamples; blurred crop proposals not admitted.
Not selected for yellow-focused pilot; no role inferred from generic source player labels.

annotation_method: HSV used only for scene screening. Roles assigned from source context, kit numbers, match-official signals and goalkeeper position; never inferred from yellow colour alone. Source bbox proposals manually reviewed, including goalkeeper/referee relabelling.
review: 58 wider ROI overlays inspected, with manual role corrections and separate goalkeeper class; all candidates are train-only, not an independent evaluation set.
